decisions.reason: Launched only in 2023 and still presented on its own page, the LED track spotlight's prospects remain uncertain while keeping a catalog luminaire on the market costs little, so the option is worth holding open until more results come in.

The LED ceiling luminaire is a recent, low-cost addition to the portfolio with no evidence yet that its value is unlikely to be realized, so real options reasoning favors keeping it rather than abandoning it prematurely.
